summary: The cut strip is mostly clean, with a stiff twinned arm pose in the crouch. The close-up has a head-turn snap between 58.03 and 58.06.

faults.what: Between 58.03 and 58.06 the head goes from near front-facing to a three-quarter turn with eyes looking off right in one frame. There is no in-between, so it reads as a snap rather than a turn leading with the eyes. The neck and hair shift at the same time. The 57.93 to 57.96 hair and head jitter is the same kind of fault but smaller.
faults.fix: Add 2-3 in-between frames on the head yaw, or smooth the head rotation curve. Lead with the eyes and add a blink on the turn.

faults.what: In the crouch he holds both arms straight out in front, nearly parallel and symmetrical. The silhouette is stiff with no clear line of action, and the hands are barely articulated.
faults.fix: Offset the two arms, with one higher and one trailing. Add a wrist or hand shape and a small overshoot.
